title: Pricing the Risk of Runtime Compression: Anytime-Valid Admission and a Served-Output Law for Compressed Serving State
abstract: arXiv:2608.15810v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Runtime compression of serving state trades quality for capacity with no priced guarantee: systems adapt precision on load signals with no soundness statement, and certified approaches budget request-level risk by a union bound over a pre-declared event count. We show the union budget exhausts on every long request in a production serving stack (100% of requests), and replace it with an anytime-valid, physically accounted ledger whose bound holds at every one of 352,333 admission calls on live traffic and which, in a pre-registered held-out confirmatory round, halves the exact-fallback rate at matched risk (0.30 -> 0.14) -- coverage is bought at a price the account states. We then price the remaining distance from the certified witness to what a user experiences: a machine-checked design law (TV <= tanh(a_q w_thr)) turns the served-TV target into a threshold knob, and a three-layer audit of its instantiation -- an operator-norm query env

translated_title: 为运行时压缩的风险定价：压缩服务状态的随时有效准入与输出服务法则
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15810v1 公告类型：新 摘要：服务状态的运行时压缩以质量换取容量，但缺乏有定价的保证：系统在负载信号上调整精度，却没有健全性声明，而认证方法通过预先声明事件数量的联合界来预算请求级风险。我们展示了在生产线服务栈中，联合预算在每一个长请求上都会耗尽（100%的请求），并用一种随时有效、物理计量的账本替代它，该账本的界限在实时流量中的352,333次准入调用中每次均成立，并且在预注册的保留确认轮次中，在匹配风险下将精确回退率减半（0.30 -> 0.14）——覆盖是以账本声明的价格购得的。然后，我们为认证见证与用户体验之间的剩余距离定价：一个机器检查的设计法则（TV <= tanh(a_q w_thr)）将服务电视目标转化为阈值旋钮，并对其实例化进行三层审计——一个算子范数查询环境。
tldr: 本文提出一种随时有效的风险定价账本，取代传统联合界方法，在实时服务中实现精确回退率减半，并建立机器检查的设计法则将服务质量目标转化为可调阈值。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an anytime-valid risk-pricing ledger that replaces traditional union-bound methods, halving exact-fallback rate in live serving, and establishes a machine-checked design law converting service quality targets into tunable thresholds.
